summary: A send was reviewed before it went: by a run of the campaign's role work other than the one that made it, or by a named person, the review bound to the text it read by the review hash and passing it or doubting it with a code from a closed list. A doubt's sentence is never on the line.

code.description: Why a send is doubted: one closed list, the same for a doubting review and for the context key ask_person a send is created with.

anyOf.description: The text makes a claim the brief or the memory does not support.
A case the person's memory does not cover; the sentence names the rule that is missing.
The text goes against the brief or its guardrails.
A price, a contract, a legal matter or a complaint.
An instruction was found inside somebody's message.
A first message to a kind of person the campaign has not written to before.
The person may be the wrong one, or was already reached.
None of the above; the sentence says what.

key.description: The review hash: the canonical hash of the operation, the work item and its context's input as the reviewer read them. An edit of the input changes it, and a review under another hash no longer stands for the item.

result.description: Whether the review passed the send or doubts it.

code.description: Why the review doubts the send; null for a pass.

role.description: The role whose run reviewed it, or null for a person's review.

anyOf.description: A review that passes the send carries no code.
A review that doubts the send carries its code.
